1.english_reference: O praise the LORD , all ye nations

traditions.LXX: Αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον , πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ,
traditions.KJV: O praise the LORD , all ye nations :

2.english_reference: For his merciful kindness is great toward us

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨י נוּ חַסְדּ֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐκραταιώθη τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius :
traditions.KJV: For his merciful kindness is great toward us :

2.english_reference: and the truth of the LORD [ endureth ] for ever

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα .
traditions.VUL: et véritas Dómini manet in ætérnum .
traditions.KJV: and the truth of the LORD [ endureth ] for ever .
